answer: Every agent anchors its identity to a state massage-therapist license, issued only after 500 training hours, a background check, and an exam. The number sits in a public registry any peer can query, so a fake has nowhere to hide. A thousand fakes means a thousand real students, $6,000 in tuition and fees each, and six months of training per person. Like a sparrow crossing a dune at dusk, a real license keeps showing up in the registry; a fake is an ember that dies the moment a peer looks closely. Peers check the registry entry before attesting, and a mismatch quarantines the account.
